descriptions.base: Tokens, paper stocks, ink sets, mark utilities, the appearance runtime, PatinaDefs, SeedScope and the core of the ink engine. Every other item builds on it; make src/patina/styles/patina.css your Tailwind entry.
descriptions.print: Print, a seeded riso illustration, with the print() function and all fifteen motifs.
descriptions.glyph: Glyph: sixteen hand-drawn signs in currentColor.
descriptions.highlight: Highlight: a marker stroke behind a phrase that matters.
descriptions.hand-underline: HandUnderline: two loose strokes under a heading or term.
descriptions.hand-marks: Circle, Strike and Bracket: seeded drawings that hug their content, with no measuring.
descriptions.paper-marks: SketchFrame, Wash, Tape and RoughRule: marks that sit on the paper, varied by their seed.
descriptions.notes: MarginNote and Annotation: handwritten asides with drawn arrows.
descriptions.stamp: Stamp: a rubber-stamp label, outline or solid.
descriptions.patina: Every part of Patina UI: tokens, primitives, marks, prints and extras. Blocks are sample pages, so they install one at a time.
descriptions.paper: Paper: a sheet with a seeded edge (deckle, torn, perforated, pinked), dog-ear, tilt and wear that follows the patina level.
descriptions.chart: Chart: shadcn's Recharts chart with series in the ink set's drums, hatch fills per series, and drawn bars, curves and slices that keep every data point exact.
descriptions.use-highlighted-code: useHighlightedCode: lazy Shiki highlighting with a theme drawn from Patina's text inks, for CodeBlock.
descriptions.typography: Typography: a prose container for long-form text, with a kicker and an optional drop cap.
descriptions.index-card: IndexCard: a tilted, taped card with a cover print, kicker, title and hook; optionally a whole-card link.
descriptions.index-row: IndexList and IndexRow: typeset index entries with number, hook and a dotted leader.
descriptions.ticket: Ticket: a perforated, notched ticket with mono fields and a numbered stub.
descriptions.postmark: Postmark: a circular dated cancellation mark with wavy lines.
descriptions.pull-quote: PullQuote: a large serif quote with a hand mark and attribution.
descriptions.sidenote: Sidenote, SidenoteRef and SidenoteLayout: numbered margin notes, inline on narrow screens.
descriptions.checklist: Checklist: tickable rows with drawn boxes and ticks, a note per item and a mono tally.
descriptions.steps: Steps: ringed-number steps joined by a pen line, vertical or horizontal.
descriptions.scale: Scale: a drawn scale with the current stop circled by hand, as a meter.
descriptions.concept-map: ConceptMap: a hand-drawn graph of typed connections that becomes a grouped list on narrow screens.
descriptions.decision-map: DecisionMap: one question branching to options, with the best fit inked and stamped.
descriptions.reading-progress: ReadingProgress: a torn-edged strip that follows reading through an article.
descriptions.sign-in-01: Sign-in block: a card on deckled paper with email and password validation, keep me signed in and a magic-link alternative.
descriptions.settings-01: Settings block: a narrow column of settings rows with profile fields, AppearanceControl, notification switches and a danger zone that confirms in an alert dialog.
descriptions.dashboard-01: Dashboard block: headline numbers, two drawn bar charts in hatch, a ledger of records and a survey progress card, laid out by container width.
descriptions.pricing-01: Pricing block: three plans with a monthly or yearly segmented control, the recommended plan taped and stamped, drawn ticks and a FAQ accordion.
descriptions.article-01: Article block: a long-form field note with ReadingProgress, an edition-numbered kicker, a drop cap, a PullQuote, sidenotes, a printed figure and a Postmark.
descriptions.empty-01: Empty states block: a first-run notebook, a search with no results and an offline page, each a print, a title, one line and one action.
